payload.title: P versus NP original RW, MCSP and THR2 note-body archive
payload.body:
# P versus NP original RW, MCSP and THR2 note-body archive

This archive preserves 1126 complete original Markdown note bodies. Original notes preserve all three nominated units, including proof attempts, counterexamples, stopping gates and model restrictions. Normal links to external full text are citations only; no external source is fetched or bundled. Including RW Note 516 as historical context does not certify its endpoint, an actual RW witness or a P versus NP conclusion.

This REVIEW is an inconclusive artifact check of scope, attribution, source-byte preservation and historical context around the existing indexed RESULT. It does not independently verify the note corpus, certify a full conjecture proof, or submit each old theorem claim as a new RESULT.

Every mathematical paragraph is retained. Only filesystem/coordination references are projected and an archival status banner is added; SOURCE-PROJECTIONS.json fixes both original and public hashes. Raw originals remain private. Historical pending permission wording is superseded by current authorization for this edition.

Li Hongmin is the authorized human contributor. Original drafting/checks were AI assisted; exact source-model identity is not independently reconstructed. Codex performed inventory, archival review and packaging. No human or heterogeneous mathematical acceptance is claimed. Own original note text: CC BY 4.0; short attributed third-party quotations retain their source rights.
